title: WIN-055 detail_evidence cross-ref drift: "salami-slicing (Section 9.1, Pattern #4)" points to wrong pattern (Pattern 4 is "Curve-Fitting Mistaken for Explanation")
description: WIN-055 (Distance-redshift Cepheid/SBF, verdict Self-Contradicted) closes its detail_evidence with: "together they provide independent but converging evidence that the dome has no extragalactic physics — a salami-slicing duplication (Section 9.1, Pattern #4)." But Pattern #4 in Section 9.1 (data/sections.json:part9) is "Curve-Fitting Mistaken for Explanation. Adding parameters always improves fit." — not salami-slicing. The six Section 9.1 patterns are: (1) Mechanism Denial, (2) Contradictory Results Both Claimed as Wins, (3) Predictions Trivially Confirmable, (4) Curve-Fitting Mistaken for Explanation, (5) Unfalsifiable Claims Counted as Confirmed, (6) Inconvenient Data Discarded. None is "salami-slicing duplication." The word "salami" appears zero times in data/sections.json and once in data/wins.json (only in WIN-055 itself) — so the concept is a hanging reference: it does not resolve to any pattern defined in the review. This looks like drift from an earlier Section 9.1 structure that has since been renumbered. The other cross-refs in the same passage still resolve: WIN-047 exists (Low-z Hubble Law aetheric); the #posthoc-standard anchor exists in docs/index.html:1583. Only the (Section 9.1, Pattern #4) parenthetical is broken.
recommended_action: Narrow prose patch. Preferred (a): drop the false parenthetical. Replace "— a salami-slicing duplication (Section 9.1, Pattern #4)." with "— the same extragalactic-null point counted twice under different measurement tools." This preserves the substance (WIN-055 and WIN-047 double-count the same underlying weakness) while removing the false cross-ref. Alternative (b): retarget to Pattern 2 ("Contradictory Results Both Claimed as Wins") or Pattern 3 ("Predictions Trivially Confirmable") — both loose fits; retargeting to a Pattern that only loosely fits perpetuates the same drift, so (a) is cleaner. If operator wants to preserve "salami-slicing" as a distinct concept, that argues for adding a Pattern 7 to Section 9.1 in a separate proposal, not repointing here.

proposed_patch.before_fragment: together they provide independent but converging evidence that the dome has no extragalactic physics — a salami-slicing duplication (Section 9.1, Pattern #4).
proposed_patch.after_fragment: together they provide independent but converging evidence that the dome has no extragalactic physics — the same extragalactic-null point counted twice under different measurement tools.
